name: Gauntlet USDC Prime
oneLiner: Ethereum Gauntlet USDC Prime V2 vault share; the Base and Arbitrum Prime vaults are separate, non-fungible tokens outside its market cap.
collateral: USDC supplied to Gauntlet-curated on-chain strategies. Ethereum uses Morpho Vault V2; Base uses MetaMorpho and Arbitrum uses MetaMorphoV1_1. Market allocations and collateral exposures are dynamic.
pegMechanism: Each ERC-4626 vault share is a claim on that exact vault's chain-local USDC assets, with an independent exchange rate affected by interest, fees and realized losses. Shares in different Prime vaults are not interchangeable; redemptions depend on the selected vault's available liquidity.

Content as of 2026-10-20: C04 rechecked the Ethereum exact product and indexed block 26236794, while the existing three-chain deployment/source review remains historical. Each receipt is a local residual proportional claim on lending NAV, not a fungible cross-chain token or direct fiat-cash claim against Circle. This sourced protocol-position departure does not resolve provider/catalog liability scope, establish a three-chain consolidated denominator or imply guaranteed USDC realization.
